rv.q: Under Jesca Prudencio’s direction, this world-premiere production is also a classic Chicago-style show, featuring fiercely committed acting in an intimate environment, in this case the Steppenwolf’s new in-the-round Ensemble Theatre.
BALD SISTERS could definitely use some more tightening when it comes to the specific scenes and overall narrative flow.
With incredible performances across the board, Bald Sisters is must-see theater.
Ms Lim delivers a passionate, multilayered performance that will remain with audiences forever.
This show makes you proud to be an American, while at the same time changing your view of what it means to be one.
Although BALD SISTERS is amusing, it's not endearing. I was primarily left perplexed.
You will definitely enjoy this touching show, whatever your ethnic or cultural background might be. And the ending is extraordinary!
